data.name: MASH Makes
data.description: MASH Makes is an Indo-Danish cleantech company that operates India's first large-scale biofuel and biochar carbon removal plant in Udupi district, Karnataka, converting waste from the cashew industry into renewable biofuel and carbon-rich biochar. In early 2025 it broke ground on Phase 2 of its Udupi facility, doubling annual production capacity to 7,000 tonnes of biofuel and 14,000 tonnes of biochar, and sells carbon removal credits via the Carbonfuture platform.
